phases.note: Cohort not announced. MHRA announced the third phase on 6 October 2026 and states selected participants will be listed on the collection page when onboarded. Phase 3 focus: post-market surveillance and broader oversight of AI-enabled medical devices across the device lifecycle.

checks.statement: Since its launch in 2024 the AI Airlock has now completed 2 testing phases with 11 innovators across 7 regulatory challenges.
The second phase of the Airlock completed in May 2026 and focused on 7 innovators across 3 regulatory challenges.
pilot programme closed in April 2025 and focused on four products.
checks.note: Pilot cohort page lists 5 technologies; 1 withdrew, leaving 4 participating.
